glosses: To divide fully or partly along a more or less straight line.

examples.text: The critical component of the photosynthetic system is the “water-oxidizing complex”, made up of manganese atoms and a calcium atom. This system splits water molecules and delivers some of their electrons to other molecules that help build up carbohydrates.
He has split his lip.
a huge vessel of exceeding hard marble split asunder by congealed water

examples.text: Did you hear Dick and Jane split? They'll probably get a divorce.
